headline: Budget execution at seven months: deficit reduced by 28.36 billion lei compared to 2025 and falls to 2.34% of GDP
summary: The consolidated general budget ran a deficit of 48.08 billion lei in the first seven months of 2026, 28.36 billion lei less than in 2025. The deficit equals 2.34% of GDP.
why: Budget execution data shows whether Romania is meeting its fiscal targets, which matters for its sovereign debt rating and bond yields.
